meta.title: Section-wise total: Σ score × weight / 100, and a later draft must not override an approved score
gaps: The vocabulary has no operation or library case for submitting section-wise evaluator scores, saving draft scores, or reading a vendor's calculated total.
The required setup with two evaluators and section weights of 60 and 40 cannot be created by an available recipe.
No supported read-back exposes the vendor's section-wise total or verifies that the later draft overrides the approved score.
